description:
Non-required nits and improvements surfaced by the code review of
explorer-fix-read-model-contract.  Four Required issues (unsafe regex
branch, non-deterministic tiebreaker, docstring error, missing idempotency
test cases) were fixed immediately post-review.  This item tracks
the remaining nit findings.

work_units.notes:
models.py:45-57 - RANKING_ELIGIBLE_VISIBILITIES and
RANKING_ELIGIBLE_TRUST_LABELS have no inline comment explaining
what other values exist and why these two were chosen.

Add a short comment above each constant listing the excluded values:
  # Excluded: "public-self-reported", "community-submission",
  #           "private", "internal"
and similar for trust labels. Makes the policy legible without
grep-ing the pipeline for all visibility/trust strings.
work_units.summary: Document eligibility constant value taxonomy in models.py

work_units.notes:
transformer.py - to_manifest_entry and to_detail_result each call
_query_timings → _build_display_timings independently.  When the
pipeline calls both for the same bundle_data, the display timings
are computed twice (O(4n) instead of O(2n)).

Add a single-line comment near the _query_timings call in
to_manifest_entry noting: "Same computation in to_detail_result -
a shared intermediate could eliminate the redundancy."

Low urgency: for ≤99 queries the cost is negligible.
work_units.summary: Note the double-pass computation in to_manifest_entry

work_units.notes:
test_read_model_contract.py - TestSelectCanonicalRow covers the
primary two-entry cases (eligible vs non-eligible, same tier newest
wins) but not a three-entry scenario with partial overlap (e.g. two
eligible rows with different dates + one non-eligible newer row).

Add a test:
  def test_three_entries_eligible_older_wins_non_eligible_newer(self):
      eligible_older = ...  # 2026-01-01, maintainer-run, public-curated
      eligible_newer = ...  # 2026-06-01, maintainer-run, public-curated
      non_eligible_newest = ...  # 2026-12-01, community-submission
      result = select_canonical_row([...])
      assert result is eligible_newer  # newest eligible, not newest overall
work_units.summary: Add test for select_canonical_row with three-entry mixed scenario
